headline: Pakistan on Saturday announced a proposed automotive policy targeting $6 billion in cumulative vehicle exports over five years, with a proposed 1% sales tax on fully electric vehicles, subject to federal cabinet approval, Arab News reports.

card.desc: Tajweez: electric gariyon par sirf 1% sales tax

caption:
Nayi auto policy: 5 saal mein $6 billion ki exports ka hadaf!
Arab News ke mutabiq PM ke adviser Haroon Akhtar Khan ne Saturday ko mujawwaza auto policy pesh ki, jis mein 5 saal mein $6 billion ki gariyon ki exports ka hadaf hai, jabke pichle maali saal taqreeban $200 million ki exports hui thin. Fully electric gariyon par sirf 1% sales tax ki tajweez hai, aur policy ko abhi federal cabinet ki manzoori chahiye.
